title: Advanced Settings
pue_tooltip: Ratio of total datacenter power to IT equipment power. 1.0 = perfect efficiency. Typical range: 1.1 (modern) to 1.8 (legacy). Used for TCO and CO2 calculations.
carbonRegion_tooltip: Regional carbon intensity (gCO2/kWh) used to estimate annual CO2 emissions. Switzerland has very low carbon intensity (~12 gCO2/kWh) due to hydropower.
shardsPerIndex_tooltip: Primary shards per index. Target 10–50 GB per shard. More shards = better parallelism but higher JVM overhead. Rule: max 20 shards per GB of heap.
unitSystem_tooltip: Binary: GiB/TiB (1 GiB = 1024 MiB) — used by Elasticsearch internally. Decimal: GB/TB (1 GB = 1000 MB) — used in storage vendor specs.
electricityCost_tooltip: Cost per kWh in your region. Used for 5-year TCO energy cost calculation. Swiss average: ~0.22 CHF/kWh, EU average: ~0.30 EUR/kWh.
projectYears_tooltip: Number of years for TCO amortization. Hardware costs are spread over this period.
